name: spooner
description: Audit a git repository's AI coding readiness, score it out of 10 with an evidence-backed gap list, then transform it in place: stack-aware pre-commit gates (lint/format/typecheck/test), commitlint + markdownlint + gitleaks, a stack-specific CI workflow (warn-only or hard), AGENTS.md generated from real commands, SDD spec/plan/tasks templates with an existence gate, and a .ai-native.yml drift ledger. Intranet/offline pre-commit variants included. Deterministic, zero-dependency TypeScript scripts.
